nodes.label: GSM-Symbolic: Understanding the Limitations of Mathematical Reasoning in LLMs
nodes.author: Iman Mirzadeh; Keivan Alizadeh; Hooman Shahrokhi; Oncel Tuzel; Samy Bengio; Mehrdad Farajtabar

nodes.label: GSM-Symbolic Templated Benchmark
nodes.rationale: Turns fixed benchmark questions into resampleable symbolic templates to expose hidden variance behind a single accuracy number.

nodes.label: GSM-NoOp (Irrelevant Clause) Test
nodes.rationale: Adds a plausible-sounding but operationally irrelevant clause; the resulting accuracy drop is not repaired even by matched in-context demonstrations of the exact needed skill.

nodes.label: Data Contamination Inference (Sec. 4.1)
nodes.rationale: Rests on an informal distributional observation rather than a formal hypothesis test; a subsequent external re-analysis found the null could not be rejected for 21 of 25 models, undercutting the contamination story.
